text_a: Ana le envió el informe a Carlos.
text_b: Carlos recibió el informe de parte de Ana.

text_a: The manager must approve Lisa's request before Friday.
text_b: Lisa must approve the manager's request before Friday.
what_differs: approver and requester are swapped

text_a: O cliente pagou o fornecedor ontem.
text_b: Ontem o fornecedor recebeu o pagamento do cliente.

text_a: Juan presentó a Pedro a su jefe.
text_b: Juan presentó a Pedro al jefe de Juan.
what_differs: 'su jefe' can mean Juan's boss or Pedro's boss

text_a: Os auditores revisaram todas as notas fiscais na semana passada.
text_b: Todas as notas fiscais foram revisadas pelos auditores na semana passada.

text_a: O relatório será enviado pela equipe de vendas.
text_b: A equipe de vendas receberá o relatório.
what_differs: the sales team sends in A but receives in B

text_a: La factura fue rechazada por contabilidad.
text_b: Contabilidad rechazará la factura.
what_differs: A is a past fact, B is a future action (rejection has not happened yet)

text_a: The server was shut down at midnight.
text_b: Someone shut down the server at midnight.
what_differs: agentless passive may mean an automatic shutdown, while B implies a person did it

text_a: Nunca deixe a porta do laboratório aberta.
text_b: A porta do laboratório deve ficar sempre fechada.

text_a: We usually back up the database on Sundays.
text_b: We always back up the database on Sundays.
what_differs: 'usually' allows exceptions, 'always' does not

text_a: Rara vez el tren llega tarde.
text_b: Casi nunca el tren llega con retraso.

text_a: Verifique os logs regularmente.
text_b: Verifique os logs todos os dias.
what_differs: 'regularmente' does not fix a period; daily may or may not be what is meant

text_a: Ningún empleado puede entrar sin credencial.
text_b: Todos los empleados necesitan credencial para entrar.

text_a: Not all tests passed.
text_b: None of the tests passed.
what_differs: 'not all' allows some passes; 'none' means zero passed

text_a: Pelo menos um gerente deve aprovar a compra.
text_b: Todos os gerentes devem aprovar a compra.
what_differs: one approval is enough vs every manager must approve

text_a: All the students didn't finish the exam.
text_b: None of the students finished the exam.
what_differs: negation scope: A can mean 'not all finished' or 'none finished'

text_a: El plan básico cuesta menos que el plan premium.
text_b: El plan premium es más caro que el básico.

text_a: Maria é tão alta quanto o irmão.
text_b: Maria e o irmão têm a mesma altura.

text_a: Our team closed more deals than any other team.
text_b: Our team closed as many deals as the best of the other teams.
what_differs: strictly more vs a tie with the top team

text_a: Juan quiere a su perro más que su esposa.
text_b: Juan quiere a su perro más de lo que su esposa lo quiere.
what_differs: A can compare Juan's love for the dog vs his wife, or Juan's love vs his wife's love for the dog

text_a: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
text_b: The storm caused the flight to be cancelled.

text_a: Ele saiu da empresa depois que o projeto fracassou.
text_b: Ele saiu da empresa porque o projeto fracassou.
what_differs: A states only sequence; B asserts the failure was the reason

text_a: Como llovió, se suspendió el partido.
text_b: Se suspendió el partido, así que llovió.
what_differs: cause and effect are reversed

text_a: Since the update, the app has been crashing.
text_b: Because of the update, the app has been crashing.
what_differs: 'since' can be read as temporal only or as causal

text_a: Los empleados que trabajan desde casa recibirán un bono.
text_b: Los empleados, que trabajan desde casa, recibirán un bono.
what_differs: restrictive (only remote workers) vs non-restrictive (all employees, who all work remotely)

text_a: Delete the files that are older than 30 days.
text_b: Remove any file created more than 30 days ago.

text_a: Os alunos que faltaram à prova podem fazê-la na segunda-feira.
text_b: Os alunos ausentes na prova podem fazê-la na segunda-feira.

text_a: Send the invoice to the sister of the client who lives in Lima.
text_b: Send the invoice to the client's sister, who lives in Lima.
what_differs: in A 'who lives in Lima' can attach to the sister or to the client

text_a: A reunião vai durar cerca de uma hora.
text_b: A reunião deve levar aproximadamente sessenta minutos.

text_a: Compra exactamente 50 sillas.
text_b: Compra unas 50 sillas.
what_differs: exact quantity vs approximate quantity

text_a: Você pode convidar até 20 pessoas.
text_b: Você pode convidar no mínimo 20 pessoas.
what_differs: upper limit vs lower limit

text_a: La entrega es a mediados de mes.
text_b: La entrega es el día 15.
what_differs: 'a mediados' is a vague range that may or may not mean exactly the 15th

text_a: The deadline is 03/04/2026 (dd/mm/yyyy).
text_b: The deadline is April 3, 2026.

text_a: La reunión es el 05/06.
text_b: La reunión es el 6 de mayo.
what_differs: 05/06 in Spanish dd/mm is 5 June, not 6 May

text_a: Primeiro instale o driver, depois reinicie o computador.
text_b: Reinicie o computador só depois de instalar o driver.

text_a: Pay the rent on the first business day of the month.
text_b: Pay the rent on the 1st of the month.
what_differs: first business day differs from the 1st when the 1st falls on a weekend or holiday

text_a: Primero llama al cliente y después envía la cotización.
text_b: Envía la cotización solo después de haber llamado al cliente.

text_a: Você pode sair mais cedo, desde que termine o relatório.
text_b: Você pode sair mais cedo e terminar o relatório.
what_differs: A makes finishing the report a condition for leaving; B does not

text_a: Answer urgent tickets first; the rest can wait until after Friday.
text_b: Answer all tickets by Friday, urgent ones first.
what_differs: A allows non-urgent tickets after Friday; B requires all by Friday

text_a: La prioridad es la seguridad; el diseño viene después.
text_b: Antes que el diseño, lo primero es la seguridad.
